create.name: Ancient Dragon Zen Gate
create.bio:
Ancient Dragon Zen Gate is a Soto Zen temple in Chicago's Lincoln Square, practising in the lineage of Shunryu Suzuki and belonging to Branching Streams, the network of centres affiliated with San Francisco Zen Center. It began in 2003 as a small group meeting once a week. In 2007 the scholar, translator and Zen priest Taigen Dan Leighton moved from the Bay Area to guide it, and the group took on a dedicated temple space. Leighton led the sangha until 2024, when Rev. Hogetsu Laurie Belzer became its guiding Dharma teacher; he remains involved as teacher emeritus, alongside several authorised Dharma teachers and practice leaders.

The temple has a meditation hall, a kitchen, a community room with a library and a back garden, and most programmes are hybrid, with an online zendo on Zoom. A Sunday morning programme of zazen, walking meditation, a Dharma talk and discussion is the usual starting point for beginners, with further sittings through the week, free meditation instruction by appointment, and private meetings with teachers. Monthly retreats range from half a day to five days, and the centre keeps a large podcast library of recorded talks, a chant book and a glossary of Zen terms online.

courses.title: Weekly meditation programmes (onsite, hybrid and online)
courses.description: Regular zazen through the week at the Lincoln Square zendo and in the online zendo, including a Sunday morning programme with walking meditation, a Dharma talk, discussion and tea, and a Monday evening sitting with service. No registration is needed for the weekly programmes.

courses.title: Five-Day Rohatsu Sesshin
courses.description: The temple's yearly retreat marking the Buddha's awakening, held in the zendo and online at the same time. Participants may join for one day or all five, with a Tuesday evening orientation and long days of sitting through to Sunday afternoon.
courses.price: $75/day. A self-determined sliding scale is available to all.

courses.title: Dokusan and Practice Discussion
courses.description: Private meetings to talk over questions and experiences in Zen practice: formal dokusan with the guiding teacher or the teacher emeritus, or a less formal practice discussion with one of the temple's senior practice leaders.

free_resources.title: Ancient Dragon Zen Gate Dharma Podcast Library
free_resources.description: A searchable archive of Dharma talks given at the temple, many hundreds of MP3 recordings by its guiding teachers, Dharma teachers and guests, playable in the browser or downloadable.

free_resources.title: Online Video Dharma Talks
free_resources.description: Recorded talks from the temple's online zendo by Taigen Dan Leighton, Douglas Floyd and Eishin Nancy Easton, on zazen and resilience and on supporting one another in practice.

free_resources.title: Chants
free_resources.description: The sangha's chant texts online, including its chant book, the Heart Sutra in English and Japanese, the Metta Sutta and the Ecosattva Vows.
